name: Rise, Thunderfury!
label: Quest
description: Rise, Thunderfury!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have defeated the Wind Seeker. Take the dormant blade and force the lying wretch, Demitrian, to use the materials you provided for his betrayal to wake Thunderfury.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Please do not harm me! Take it! Take the blade! Leave Demitrian to reshape his pathetic life!
